Abstract

A solid-body stringed instrument on outline C-75. Bolted neck of 25.5 scale; pickups, bridge and controls of the T type. The disclosure relates generally to music, and specifically to an established precedent.

Claims

What is claimed is:

  1. A stringed instrument comprising a solid body (10) 2.0 deep on outline C-75, a neck (40) attached by bolts, and a scale of 25.5.
  2. The instrument of claim 1, bevelled 5/8 top and back, leaving a 3/4 square band, the middle of the tail left square.
  3. The instrument of claim 1, the neck seated in a pocket of the standard pattern at the sixteenth fret, such that any neck made for that pocket would fit it, and no such neck would have its headstock.
  4. The instrument of claim 1, the headstock inclined at 11.2° with a volute, whereby no string tree is required.
  5. The instrument of claim 1, having twenty-one (21) nickel-silver frets on an ebony fingerboard (42) of 12 radius.
  6. The instrument of claim 1, having a bridge pickup (22) in a three-saddle plate (20), strings passing through the body, and a covered neck pickup (24) on springs.
  7. The instrument of claim 1, having a control plate (30) parallel to the treble bevel, and a jack (34) on the flat of the treble lower bevel, where Case No. C-75 carries its own.
  8. The instrument of claim 1, no pickguard being present.

Conditions of use

Form JPI-75T
The INSTRUMENT is to be operated by hand. Other methods of operation have not been evaluated.
  1. For use outside BILLABLE HOURS.
  2. The scale exceeds that of the C-75 by 0.75. OPERATORS moving between instruments shall allow for this.
  3. The neck (40) is bolted. It may be removed. Removal is not a condition of use.
  4. The precedent for this instrument shall not be cited by name.
  5. Hours of operation are recorded as NON-BILLABLE. Entries to date: none.
Caution

Neck pocket. Do not operate the INSTRUMENT with the pocket empty.

Manufacture and custody

Procedure JPI-M-1T
  1. Body (10), of one or two pieces, machined in two setups: top, then back.
  2. Bevels cut with a 1/4 in ball-nose.
  3. Neck (40) made to the Corporation’s pattern on a standard heel, and bolted.
  4. Hardware fitted per Sheet 2.
  5. On production, the serial is entered in the ledger. No entry has been made.
